articles.title: Timor-Leste charts a path towards its first national disaster risk reduction strategy
articles.description: Convened by the Civil Protection Authority (CPA) with support from UNDRR and funding from the Government of Portugal, a multi-stakeholder consultation marked a milestone toward developing Timor-Leste's first national disaster risk reduction strategy.

articles.title: Algeria advances multi-hazard early warning systems through national workshop
articles.description: A national workshop held in Algiers on 8–9 November 2026 assessed early warning capacities, identified key gaps, and advanced preparations for Algeria’s Early Warnings for All National Roadmap (2027–2030).

articles.title: From early warning to early action: How six countries are saving lives
articles.description: This article explores how six countries are strengthening early warning systems, turning risk information into action that helps protect communities from disasters.

articles.title: Resilience starts with you: World Tsunami Awareness Day marked at UN Headquarters
articles.description: World Tsunami Awareness Day 2026 was commemorated at UNHQ in New York, on November 5th, 2026, bringing together governments, UN agencies and partners, under the theme 'Resilience Starts With You'.

articles.title: Global Status of Multi-Hazard Early Warning Systems 2026
articles.description: This edition of the multi-hazard early warning systems (MHEWS) report provides a snapshot of the progress made in the global roll-out of MHEWS and the gaps that remain.

articles.title: The first international Youth AGI Artwork competition for Tsunami responding to disasters officially begins!
articles.description: This event is open to school-aged youth worldwide and encourages participants to use AGI/AIGC tools to create innovative works on tsunami prevention and mitigation.

articles.title: £2 million to back Global South leadership on loss and damage
articles.description: The Scottish Government will provide £2 million to help countries in the Global South lead their own response to loss and damage, including £500,000 for a new partnership with the UN Office for Disaster Risk Reduction.

articles.title: Early warning protection expands worldwide as powerful El Niño raises the stakes
articles.description: 70 per cent of countries now report having multi-hazard early warning systems, but major gaps persist in the countries most at risk.

articles.title: Asia-Pacific Ministerial Conference on Disaster Risk Reduction
articles.description: The Government of Japan, in partnership with the United Nations Office for Disaster Risk Reduction (UNDRR), will host the 2027 Asia-Pacific Ministerial Conference on Disaster Risk Reduction from 25 to 29 October 2027 in Sendai City, Japan.

articles.title: Instituto Bem Ambiental (IBAM)
articles.description: The Instituto Bem Ambiental is a Brazilian non-governmental, non-profit organization founded in 2015 with a bold mission: to catalyze transformative environmental action that enhances climate resilience, restores ecosystems, and empowers communities.

articles.title: Global Status of Multi-Hazard Early Warning Systems 2026
articles.description: Now in its fifth year, this edition of the Global Status Report (GSR) of multi-hazard early warning systems (MHEWS) provides a snapshot of the progress made in the global roll-out of MHEWS and the gaps that remain.

articles.title: Chile puts tsunami preparedness into practice as 328,000+ join a region-wide evacuation drill
articles.description: On World Tsunami Awareness Day, more than 328,000 people from over 1,000 kindergartens, schools and higher education institutions in Chile’s Valparaíso region practised an earthquake and tsunami evacuation, joined by UNDRR head Kamal Kishore.

articles.title: Six communities creating a culture of tsunami readiness
articles.description: Communities around the world are rising to the challenge of tsunami resilience, creating a global wave of readiness, so that warnings and evacuation routes work for the people most at risk of being left behind.

articles.title: Regional workshop on coastal resilience: strengthening early warning, preparedness, and anticipatory action in the Mediterranean
articles.description: The regional workshop in Lebanon will bring together Mediterranean Arab States and partners to strengthen coastal risk knowledge, multi-hazard early warning systems, preparedness, and anticipatory action through regional cooperation.

articles.title: Lebanon marks World Tsunami Awareness Day with national workshop on coastal resilience, science, and youth engagement
articles.description: On World Tsunami Awareness Day, more than 80 university students in Lebanon engaged in a national workshop and student competition focused on coastal resilience, early warning systems, and translating scientific knowledge into anticipatory action.

articles.title: UNDRR and Japan showcase tsunami innovation at Geneva policy dialogue
articles.description: To commemorate World Tsunami Awareness Day – marked each year on 5 November – UNDRR held an innovation showcase and policy dialogue, generously hosted by the Permanent Mission of Japan in Geneva.

articles.title: Droughts, floods and food systems risk dialogue – Part III: Turning Food System Risk into Food System Resilience: Innovative Solutions for Drought Management
articles.description: Participants will explore how risk-reduction finance can buffer against global food price shocks and volatility, and how investment in regenerative farming techniques and climate-smart agriculture can contribute to food-system resilience.

articles.title: Mozambique learns from Japan’s expertise in disaster risk reduction
articles.description: As Mozambique works to strengthen its disaster risk reduction mechanisms, representatives led by INGD, and supported by Ministry of Finance and Eduardo Mondlane University, embarked on a study tour to Nagoya, Japan.
